dedupe_keys.name: road space point cloud of schwarzer berg in brunswick excerpt

description: DLR and iMAR Navigation publish a mobile-mapping point-cloud excerpt from Schwarzer Berg in Brunswick, Germany. Two LAZ files represent observations from the left and right sides of the survey vehicle, acquired in early 2024. The November 2025 release is freely downloadable for non-commercial reuse under CC BY-NC 4.0. Its README describes merging, clipping and spatial referencing with PDAL, using ETRS89/DREF91/2016 UTM zone 32N and EGM2008 heights. These observations can build or check road-environment geometry for driving simulations. Coverage is only the central part of the surveyed neighbourhood, and positional uncertainty and point classification remain unspecified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the excerpt. The separately deposited OpenDRIVE map is a derived road representation, not an equivalent point-cloud payload. No point data were downloaded or processed.
